title: DEV: Clear the workflow trigger cache after event listener specs
body:
`WorkflowDependency.cache` is kept in memory, so the DB rollback between examples doesn't clear it. `event_listener_spec.rb` only cleared it before each example, so its last example left cached triggers for workflows that no longer exist. A later spec that fired `:user_seen` for a new user then enqueued a stray `ExecuteWorkflow` job. That is what broke the `Jobs.enqueue` spy in `DiscourseAi::Discover::DiscoveriesController#reply` ([flaky run](https://github.com/discourse/discourse/actions/runs/35917147173)).

This PR also clears the cache after each example. To reproduce the failure without this fix:

```sh
bin/rspec --order defined \
  plugins/discourse-workflows/spec/lib/discourse_workflows/event_listener_spec.rb:286 \
  plugins/discourse-ai/spec/requests/discover/discoveries_controller_spec.rb:60
```


Related to https://patch.discourse.org/patch-triage/2660
